skin.title: Skin & Appearance
skin.groupSkinsDesc: Switch between native stock KohakuTerrarium, built-in example skins, or imported community skin packs.
skin.groupBgDesc: Overlay a custom wallpaper or follow the active skin's default background. Works even when no UI skin is loaded.
skin.defaultDesc: Stock KohakuTerrarium appearance with zero skin CSS or token overrides.
skin.rowModeHint: Choose whether to hide the background layer, follow the active skin, or use a custom image.
skin.rowWallpaperHint: Upload a local PNG/JPG/WebP/GIF/SVG image or paste an image URL.
skin.rowFitHint: Control how the background image scales inside the viewport.
skin.rowAlphaHint: Adjust translucency of rails, tabs, panels, and cards over the background image.
skin.rowBlurHint: Backdrop blur radius applied to translucent surfaces.
skin.rowDimHint: Veil over the wallpaper to preserve text readability.
skin.rowReadabilityHint: Strengthen frosted reading plates, text contrast, and panel or message borders over the wallpaper.
skin.rowPresetsHint: One-click balance between crisp text readability and vivid wallpaper visibility.
skin.confirmDelete: Delete custom skin "{name}"? This removes its folder from your custom skins directory.
skin.toastUrlEmpty: Please enter an image URL first.
skin.toastUnsupportedSkinFile: Only .zip skin packs and .css files are supported.
skin.toastInvalidUrlScheme: URL must start with https:// or http://
skin.builtin.sakura-washi.name: Sakura Washi
skin.builtin.sakura-washi.desc: Warm Japanese handmade washi paper with vermilion-sakura crimson, gold-leaf Asanoha geometry, and petal-glow editorial bubbles.
skin.builtin.tsukimi-anime.name: Moonlit Anime
skin.builtin.tsukimi-anime.desc: Twilight indigo-violet cel-sky moonlight aesthetic with luminous silver-cyan glow, frosted anime HUD glass cards, and starlight dialogue bubbles.
skin.groupIntroDesc: Play a one-shot cinematic startup sequence and seamlessly keep its animated scene or loop video as your live workspace wallpaper.
skin.introEnableHint: Activate the selected intro cinema and optional persistent live wallpaper.
skin.introStartupHint: Automatically play the fullscreen intro once when opening KohakuTerrarium.
skin.introKeepLiveHint: Hand off the final artwork or loop video with ambient particles into the background layer.
skin.introMuteHint: Keep startup audio muted by default.
skin.introVolumeHint: Playback volume for intro music or built-in starlight synth chords.
skin.introEmpty: No intro packs found. Create one or import a .zip pack.
skin.introConfirmDelete: Delete custom intro pack "{name}"? This removes its folder from your custom intros directory.
skin.introToastNoActive: Enable or select an intro pack first to preview.
skin.workshopSubtitle: Zero-code wizard for 1-Image Auto Cinema or MP4/WebM Video intros with live wallpaper support.
skin.workshopFocalHint: Click image to set climax focal burst point: ({x}%, {y}%)
skin.workshopUseSynthAudio: Use built-in Starlight synth chords when no audio file is uploaded
skin.workshopErrName: Please enter a name for the intro pack.
skin.workshopErrHeroImage: Please select a hero artwork image.
skin.workshopErrVideoFile: Please select an intro video file.
